text: The fundamental group π₁(X, x₀) has as elements:
choices: homotopy classes of maps S² → X
homotopy classes of loops based at x₀ (maps [0,1]→X with f(0)=f(1)=x₀)
all paths from x₀ to other points
explanation: π₁(X, x₀) = {[f] | f:[0,1]→X, f(0)=f(1)=x₀} / homotopy rel {0,1}. Group operation = path concatenation; inverse = path reversal.
